name: Voomp IA · Listar Produtos do Seller

parameters.query:
SELECT
  p.id,
  p.name,
  p.status,
  p.amount,
  p.method,
  p.format,
  p.warranty,
  p.max_installments,
  img.path AS thumbnail
FROM voompcreators_back_prd.products p
LEFT JOIN voompcreators_back_prd.products_has_images img
  ON img.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.seller_id = {{ $json.sellerId }}
  AND p.status = 'APPROVED'
  AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY p.name ASC
LIMIT 100
